observed.caption: A vibrant indoor market stall displays colorful bowls, carved figurines, chess sets, masks, and hanging graphic T-shirts with vendors sitting among the goods.
observed.description: The photo shows a densely packed market stall viewed at eye level. In the foreground, hundreds of small colorful carved animal figurines, painted wooden bowls and plates with animal and landscape motifs, and carved wooden masks are spread on a brown tarp over a concrete floor marked with a yellow line. A blue chessboard with black and blue pieces sits atop a green plastic barrel on the left, with additional chess sets on blue barrels behind it. Behind the bowls, wooden giraffe carvings and other dark wood sculptures are clustered. Folded bright striped textiles in red, blue, orange and purple are stacked to the right. The back wall is covered with hanging T-shirts and fabrics featuring Africa-shaped graphics, maps, and text, alongside patterned cloths. Several people are seated among the merchandise: a person in a green jacket and dark pants sitting on a blue barrel in the center-right, a person in a dark jacket and light pants sitting on a green stool in the background, a person with a yellow hat seated behind the central figure, a person in a pink top partially visible behind fabrics on the left, and a partial view of a standing person's foot and shoe at the bottom right edge. The setting is a covered indoor market with bright even lighting.
